paper.title: Using the Retail Distribution of Sellers to Impute Expenditure Shares

abstract.reason: 首页作者署名之后、JEL 分类号之前的段落概括了研究问题、支出份额推算方法和主要发现，可以识别为摘要。

evidence.quote:
(Jimmy) Xu*
Many price indices must be constructed without quantity data at the 
elementary level. The paper shows that for some consumer goods in 
the United States and other countries, one can approximate expen-

diture shares using weights derived from the retail distribution of 
sellers. These weights are based on the share of outlets selling an 
item, or the share of outlets adjusted by the total number of items 
sold in

each. Relative to using no weights, the paper finds that using 
such imputed weights substantially reduces bias in the frequency of 
price changes, in annual inflation, and in price comparisons across 
countries. (JEL

E31, L11, L81, O11, O14)
